english.meaning: to carry on the back or shoulder
english.note: 孭結他 means to sling a guitar over the shoulder.

exampleSentences.english: Just sling the guitar over your shoulder and go.

exampleSentences.english: Then someone helped me with those things. Later, I couldn’t walk at all, so a guy carried me off.
exampleSentences.traditional: 跟住後來呢就有人幫我，誒，整嗰啲嘢囖。跟住後來我直程行唔到嘍。有個男仔孭我走喇。
